name: Daikoku Denki Co., Ltd.
summary: Daikoku Denki Co., Ltd. development, production, and sale of computer systems pachinko parlors in Japan. The company operates through Information system business and Amusement business segments. It also develops, manufactures, and sells units for pachinko and pachislot gaming machines. In addition, the company provides Daikoku Denki Strategic Information System, a service system to help pachinko hall operators formulate management strategies; and information on pachinko halls and game machines through PC and cell-phone Web sites, and pay TV channels. Daikoku Denki Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.
